name: Blood Age
description: Era of violent clashes between warring armies, ended by a fragile peace.

description_citations.text: "Shadrix Silverquill". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Extus begins his research into forbidden Blood Age magic.
timeline.quote: Strixhaven forbade all magic from the Blood Age, so that is where Extus began his research.

citation.text: Plumb the Forbidden (Strixhaven: School of Mages, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Blood Age ends when five elder dragons found Strixhaven University.
timeline.quote: It was only when five mighty elder dragons came together and founded Strixhaven University that the Blood Age finally came to an end

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Secrets of Strixhaven
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Secrets of Strixhaven" by Lauren Bond, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: The Fields of Strife are formed during the Blood Age of Arcavios.
timeline.quote: The Fields of Strife were formed during the Blood Age of Arcavios

citation.text: "Fields of Strife", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A mana disturbance from the Blood Age creates the Paradox Gardens.
timeline.quote: An unknown mana disturbance from the Blood Age gave rise to a magic-suffused region in the southeast

citation.text: "Paradox Gardens", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the Blood Age, Shadrix founds the Forum of Amity to preserve the peace.
timeline.quote: Shadrix Silverquill founded the Forum of Amity in the northeastern reaches of Arcavios as a seat of diplomacy

citation.text: "Shadrix Silverquill", section "The Forum of Amity". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.quote: The Founder Dragons brought the Blood Age to an end.

citation.text: Dragonsguard Elite (Strixhaven: School of Mages Promos, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
